name: external-service-pings-failed
title: Serve has not received a Pingdom health check
description: No successful request to /health-check/pingdom was recorded in the last 5 minutes. Serve may be unavailable.
investigation_steps: Open the Serve public URL and check that /health-check/pingdom responds with HTTP 200. See if the service can be reached and is functioning correctly.
Check the production frontend ECS service and task health, then inspect the Serve logs for any errors that may indicate why the health check failed.
If production users cannot use Serve, raise an incident and escalate.
